profile.headline: CS @ Georgia Tech | Prev @ AmEx, The Home Depot
profile.summary:
Computer Science student at Georgia Tech with experience in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, machine learning, and data analytics. My background includes developing and deploying applications, building machine learning solutions on Google Cloud, working with enterprise financial and SAP data, and designing cloud-native systems using Docker, APIs, and modern infrastructure tools.

Experienced in software development, cloud technologies, infrastructure engineering, and data-driven problem solving, with interests in scalable systems, artificial intelligence, and technology that drives business impact.

positions.title: Wreck Tech
positions.description:
Managed technical support for campus networks, optimizing WiFi connectivity and system performance
Enhanced student tech engagement through proactive team collaboration and service initiatives
Advanced technical proficiency in troubleshooting software and hardware connectivity issues

positions.title: Facilities Assistant

Analyze and report gym usage statistics and member feedback to improve services
Manage an integrated gym management software system for member tracking, usage, and facility booking
